title: articles_db public functions lack doc comments
description: articles_db.rs exports 14 public async functions (create_collection, get_collection, list_user_collections, update_collection, delete_collection, create_article, get_article, get_article_by_slug, list_collection_articles, list_user_articles, update_article, delete_article, increment_views, pin_article, unpin_article, move_to_collection) and 2 public row types. None of the functions have doc comments documenting preconditions (e.g., update_article silently no-ops if id doesn't exist), error conditions, or what happens on constraint violations. Same pattern applies to books_db.rs and audio_db.rs. For a library consumed by 3 servers, missing docs = missing contract.
close_reason: Deferred: doc comments are polish. Function signatures are self-documenting (create/get/list/update/delete pattern). Will add when preparing for crates.io publish.
